preregistration_protocol_rows.registered_protocol_object: Preregistered analysis plan, registered report, challenge protocol, forecast protocol, decision-experiment protocol, or metadata-only protocol invoked by FAMILYC-EW-CODE.
preregistration_protocol_rows.pre_analysis_plan_test: Declare hypotheses/target claims, primary outcomes, acquisition plan, analysis code or formula, exclusion/nuisance rules, stopping rule, versioned registration timestamp, and review/adjudication status before using preregistration language.
preregistration_protocol_rows.deviation_or_exploration_policy: Preregistered and exploratory analyses may both be valuable, but deviations, additions, exclusions, and post-hoc analyses must be labeled and routed through blinding/deviation rows before support can be spent.

preregistration_protocol_rows.forbidden_inference: Do not infer prediction, severe testing, independent confirmation, or candidate support from the existence of a preregistration or registered report alone.
